notes:
Adds several PPL(ASEL/AMEL)-side fixes and features:
- Fixes the "Check for Updates" button: a JS bug made the update-status banner on the report page silently blank (this only affected the update-status display, not grading).
- Power-On/Power-Off Stall: optional Vso/Vs1 entry in Settings arms the stall off indicated airspeed too, for add-ons whose stall-warning sound never fires.
- Turns to Headings: the assigned heading and turn direction (left/right) are now shown before you press Ready, not only after.
- Turns Around a Point: more forgiving circle-completion check, so a normal correction turn no longer prevents the task from ever finishing.
- Emergency Descent: optional target airspeed in Settings, instead of always grading around whatever speed it happened to be armed at.
- Normal Approach and Landing now has its own approach-speed setting -- it was incorrectly reusing Short-Field's speed before.
- Go-Around/Rejected Landing no longer needs Ready: it's watched for throughout the flight and graded whenever it happens.
- The report page now shows a flight-path map for every flight, not just the latest, and each flight in History has its own page/link.
